questions.stem: A patient with salicylic acid poisoning has the following arterial blood gas analysis report: pH = 7.3, pCO2=16mmHg, HCO3—6.3mmol/L, Na+-135, K+- 4.5 CI-113.7, lactate was normal. Which of the following options correctly describes the condition?
questions.stemHtml: A patient with salicylic acid poisoning has the following arterial blood gas analysis report: pH = 7.3, pCO2=16mmHg, HCO3—6.3mmol/L, Na+-135, K+- 4.5 CI-113.7, lactate was normal. Which of the following options correctly describes the condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Metabolic acidosis with partial compensated respiratory alkolosis with high anion gap

options.label: B
options.text: Respiratory acidosis with compensatory metabolic alkalosis

options.label: C
options.text: Metabolic acidosis with uncompensated respiratory alkalosis
